title: Retention drift in test export bucket

sections.heading: Finding
paragraphs: Risk RR-047. An isolated test export bucket lacked the approved expiry tag. The bucket contained synthetic data used in an integration exercise.

sections.heading: Mitigation
paragraphs: Add a configuration check that rejects export buckets without an expiry setting. Review the exception list after the change deploys in both service regions.

sections.heading: Ownership
paragraphs: Data Engineering owns remediation. Security verifies the control. The target review date is 16 November.
